text:
ben_marketing: Creative ops ask — need 4 benchmark tiles + 2 webinar hero frames for the inbound journey. Must be brand-compliant, light + dark variants, and localized (EN-US, EN-GB, FR). Delivery target: EOD Thu. Can @design-team confirm capacity?

anya_design: Got it. Quick Qs — what exact sizes and file formats do we want? Also do we need separate social crops or will marketing crop from hero?

ben_marketing: Sizes: tiles 1200x800 (desktop card), social crop 1080x1080 (square) exported separately, hero 1920x1080. File types: PNG for final, SVG for any iconography/illustrative elements. Please include a layered Figma file.

anya_design: Perfect. Any copy final yet for localizations? We need the strings and a glossary for FR tone.

ben_marketing: Copy draft in docs (link): https://redwood.design/briefs/inbound-bench-2026 — includes primary headlines + CTAs. Carmen will send FR translations by EOD Wed. Use British spelling for EN-GB (colour, optimise).

carmen: Sending FR copy here — also flagged two lines that need shortening for tiles (headline character limits). I put short/long variants in the doc.

anya_design: Thanks. I'll mock the tile lockups with both short and long headline variants so ops can pick.

design-bot: Task created: #CR-3127 assigned to anya_design, due 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC. Assets: 4 tiles (x2 themes) + 2 heroes (x2 themes) + social crops + export package.

kevin_legal: Quick legal note — if any imagery references partner logos or third-party datasets, we need clearance. Also we should avoid using the phrase "industry-leading" in hero copy without claim support. Please route final copy to @legal for sign-off before publish. Alt text required for all final images.

anya_design: Noted. We'll swap any partner logos with neutral silhouettes until cleared. I'll add alt text templates in the export.

jake_ops: For inbound routing, filename metadata is important. Can we standardize exports as: campaign_region_variant_language.png? Example: inbound_na_bench_v1_en-US.png. I can accept a CSV mapping if you want bulk uploads to the routing system.

ben_marketing: Yes please, jake — provide CSV with filename -> campaign mapping. We want region tags: na, eu, apac. Variant = benchA or benchB (colorway). Language tag per ISO. Deadline for CSV: Wed EOD.

anya_design: I have one more ask for QA: who signs off final visuals? I can push a draft to the marketing QA board but want a named approver to avoid back-and-forth.

olivia_marketing: I'll be final approver for marketing. If legal flags copy, we'll pause publish. Olivia here — will review proofs by Thu morning.

anya_design: Great — I'll drop a Figma link and export spec here once first drafts are ready.

Export specs (to include in Figma handoff):
- Tile (desktop): 1200x800 px, PNG (rgb sRGB) + layered Figma file + SVG icons
- Social crop: 1080x1080 px, PNG
- Hero: 1920x1080 px, PNG. Provide 2 aspect ratios: 16:9 (hero) and 4:5 (email header)
- Safe area/margins: 48 px
- Typography: Redwood Display + Redwood Sans (use token names in figma)
- Color: provide light and dark palettes; include accessible contrast checks
- File naming: campaign_region_variant_lang.png (see jake_ops)
- Metadata: add alt text field and short description in export CSV

anya_design: Figma link (working file): https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/inbound-bench-ops — drafts by Wed afternoon.

ben_marketing: Thanks team. If anyone needs copy tweaks or extra sizes for paid channels, flag now. Otherwise we proceed to draft->legal->olivia QA flow. :rocket:

kevin_legal: I'll stand by to review copy after drafts. Please include a brief rationale if we use comparative claims.

anya_design: Will do. Assigning time blocks: mockups Wed afternoon, internal review Wed evening, legal Thu morning, Olivia final Thu midday.

ben_marketing: Solid. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will loop in social ops once assets are signed off. :thumbsup:
